# Security and Compliance
- Prefer deny-by-default authorization and least privilege; review rules and policies before relaxing them.
- Do not commit secrets, credentials, private keys, production identifiers, or real personal/financial data.
- Validate and authorize every sensitive operation server-side; log security-relevant events without exposing secrets or unnecessary personal data.
- Treat authentication, KYC, payments, refunds, payouts, certificates, and admin access as security-sensitive workflows requiring review and tests.
- Corrected V2.1 overrides conflicting V2.0 requirements. The source documents are not yet in this workspace; do not infer compliance obligations.
- Do not create cloud resources, deploy, or enable live payments without explicit approval.
